review: R68 J independent runtime review and fix verification

findings.finding: Production mergeByMaterial.normalizeAttributes removed vertex color attribute from new SuiChu stone facing while material.vertexColors remained true. Pre-merge tests missed it.
findings.fix: Only this facing sets noMerge=true; shared merge utility unchanged.
findings.verification: Actual CourtKit.finish preserves exact color array, world matrix, material vertexColors, and releases owned geometry/material exactly once.

findings.finding: Stone facing is part of existing platform support, not a new above-ground obstruction; custom role prevented existing terrain recognition.
findings.fix: role=platform-base, detailRole=r68-suichu-tiger-stone-facing; eliminate former 0.002 m outward offset and use polygonOffset=true, factor=-1, units=-1. No physics changes.
findings.verification: Facing lies wholly within original platform envelope and exactly on south plane within 1e-6; south normals Z<-0.999. Existing terrain whitelist and STEP_UP/body intersection assertions unchanged.

scope: Five exact J hosts: 33 generic meshes and corresponding 30 colliders removed; remaining geometry and collider hashes compared against baseline.
12 non-target halls preserve geometry and navigation hashes.
BiLuo five-layer finial finite vertices and consecutive vertical bounds without gaps.
Production CourtKit.finish color preservation and resource disposal.

limitations: Reviewer did not run full-world acceptance, production build, HTTP package checks, or real GPU/mobile tests. These remain implementation/release-owner responsibilities.
CPU geometry and Node tests are not real GPU acceptance.
This report does not assert GitHub upload or Pages deployment.
